description: This file defines API routes for managing RSVPs within an event management system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints to list, create, and delete RSVPs for specific events, interacting with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models.

methods.name: RSVPPublic _to_public(r: RSVP)
methods.description: Converts an RSVP ORM model instance to a RSVPPublic schema instance.

methods.name: list[RSVPPublic] list_rsvps(event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all RSVPs for a specific event.

methods.name: RSVPPublic create_rsvp(event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new RSVP for the current user on the specified event.

methods.name: None delete_rsvp(event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove the RSVP of the current user from the specified event.
